verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own REST API can list registered clients with online status, retrieve session history, and close an active session. Its portal also advertises monitoring sessions and managing devices. All of this is account- and API-level control, not a host-side view of who is connected right now with a disconnect or revoke action, and device revocation is not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: host-side display of current connections, a documented disconnect action on the host, explicit revoke-device or permission-removal capability, and hands-on corroboration.
